findings.detail: The source says Damian is increasing both his training and his duties as Robin. The translation conveys increased training load but only says that he performs Robin's duties. Preserve that his Robin duties are also increasing.

source_anchor.quote: while also increasing his training and duties as Robin.

translation_anchor.quote: а также увеличивал нагрузку на тренировках и выполнял обязанности Робина.

findings.detail: «Борьба с преступностью» conveys crimefighting generally but loses the source's specific implication of teenage vigilante activity. Preserve that distinction in the target wording.

source_anchor.quote: the strain of balancing school and teenage vigilantism.

translation_anchor.quote: как тяжело совмещать школу и подростковую борьбу с преступностью.

findings.detail: The source says Damian responds «curtly», conveying brusqueness as well as brevity. «Короче» preserves shortness but not the curt tone; retain that edge in his response.

source_anchor.quote: Damian responds as swiftly and curtly as possible, trying to get the pleasantries over with as soon as possible.

translation_anchor.quote: Дэмиан отвечает как можно быстрее и короче, стараясь поскорее покончить с обменом любезностями.

findings.detail: «Этичного воплощения» sounds like a calque in this business context. Consider a more natural equivalent such as «этичной реализации» while preserving the source’s emphasis on ethical execution.

source_anchor.quote: His current assistant is taking the summer off

findings.detail: The translation says «его отцов» (his fathers), changing the number of the referent. In the surrounding context the source refers to Damian’s father in the singular; the source phrase appears to have a missing possessive apostrophe. Render the intended singular reference, such as «наставления отца».

source_anchor.quote: But his Fathers teachings have truly cemented.

translation_anchor.quote: Но наставления его отцов и впрямь глубоко укоренились в нём.

findings.detail: «В принципе ни на что не годен» broadens the worry from being fundamentally bad at this job to being good for nothing in general. Keep the concern scoped to the role or task.

source_anchor.quote: What if he is fundamentally bad at it?

translation_anchor.quote: А вдруг он в принципе ни на что не годен?

style.evidence: The sequence beginning “What if he is fundamentally bad at it?” and ending “But still.”
style.source_pattern: Damian’s close-third-person interiority includes a cascade of anxious rhetorical questions, followed by a brief self-correcting aside and a clipped closing thought.
style.translation_approach: Preserve the escalation and rhetorical-question sequence, then retain the abrupt self-correction and short concluding beat rather than smoothing them into explanatory prose.

findings.detail: «Отъезд Тэм будет словно лишиться руки» is grammatically mismatched: it compares a departure to an infinitive. Recast it naturally, for example, as «для него это будет всё равно что лишиться руки».

source_anchor.quote: Even so, having Tam gone will be like losing a limb.

translation_anchor.quote: И все же отъезд Тэм будет словно лишиться руки.

findings.detail: «Растянуть напряжение» is an unnatural collocation in Russian. Preserve the physical effort of stretching while using a natural phrase, such as «попытаться размять мышцы между лопатками» or «снять напряжение».

source_anchor.quote: Tim leans his head heavily to his shoulder, trying in vain to stretch out the tension building between his shoulder blades.

translation_anchor.quote: Тим тяжело склоняет голову к плечу, тщетно пытаясь растянуть напряжение, накапливающееся между лопатками.

findings.detail: «Уладить дедлайны» is an unnatural collocation and obscures the sense of getting the quarter’s deadlines and work out of the way. Rephrase so the deadlines are met or the work due by them is completed.

source_anchor.quote: With Tam getting ready to go on her vacation, the two of them have been putting in the work to get most of the major decisions and deadlines for the quarter out of the way.

translation_anchor.quote: Пока Тэм готовится к отпуску, они вдвоем стараются заранее уладить большинство важных вопросов и дедлайнов на этот квартал.

findings.detail: In context, Tim says he may have something else he wants to work on, and Tam’s elliptical “You don’t” means he does not have anything else to work on. «Не хочется» changes this to a statement about his desire, and the following «даже если бы хотелось» repeats that shift. Preserve the implied meaning that he has no other work to do.

source_anchor.quote: “You don’t,” she says matter of factly. “And even if you did, it’s been like 15 hours. That’s where I draw the line.”

translation_anchor.quote: «Не хочется», — говорит она как ни в чем не бывало. «И даже если бы хотелось, прошло уже часов пятнадцать. Вот тут я и провожу черту».

findings.detail: The source says the program is meant to encourage promising young people to apply. «Рассчитана на перспективную молодёжь» instead describes whom the program is intended for, omitting the stated aim of encouraging applications.

findings.detail: “Thinks they know better than him” refers to believing oneself more knowledgeable or better informed; «считает себя умнее него» shifts this to intelligence. A closer rendering would preserve the idea that the person thinks they know more or know better than Tim.
